versions.localizedDescription:
### Choose what happens when something else is playing

Settings has a new **Audio** section. If you keep Music or a podcast running while
you play, pick how Apotris should share:

- **Stop Other Audio** — music and podcasts stop when Apotris starts
- **Play Both** — both play together, neither one quieter
- **Lower Other Audio** — music and podcasts drop to the background; game audio stays full *(default)*
- **Lower Game Audio** — game audio drops to the background while another app is playing
- **Mute Game Audio** — game audio goes silent while another app is playing

Each option explains itself in the picker, so you don't have to guess which side
gets quieter. The last two fade over about a fifth of a second rather than cutting,
and they sit on top of the game's own Music and Sound sliders — the in-game options
keep working and are never overwritten by the ducking.

There's a master **Game volume** slider in the same section.

### If you play with music going

Two things changed from earlier builds. Apotris used to mix with other audio at full
volume and follow the ring/silent switch; it now uses the audio category those five
modes need. So by default other audio is **lowered** while you play — pick **Play
Both** for the old behaviour — and game sound keeps playing with the ring/silent
switch off. Turn Game volume down if you want it quiet.

### Also

- Sound comes back after a phone call or Siri interrupts it. Previously the audio
  stayed dead until you left the app and came back.

### Pick up where you left off

Leaving the app now saves your run, so a force-quit — or a reboot, or iOS
evicting the app — no longer loses a long game. **Continue** appears at the top
of the main menu on the next launch and puts you back exactly where you were:
board, active piece, hold, next queue, score, level, timer and grade progress.

Backgrounding on its own never ended a run (the game just pauses in place), so
this only kicks in when the app actually stops running.

One slot, and it's cleared once you resume — a run you carried to a game over
can't be reloaded and re-rolled onto the leaderboards.

### Also

- README: the FAQ still claimed online multiplayer wasn't in the build. It has
  been since 1.1.7 — Multi Battle, private rooms by code, up to 5 players.

---

**Install:** sideload the IPA with SideStore / AltStore (iOS) or
[iloader](https://github.com/rebelancap/iloader/releases#release-visionos)
(Apple Vision Pro). Requires iOS 17+ / visionOS 2+.

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)

A small follow-up to 1.1.7.

## Fixed
- **visionOS Settings** now describe the actual pinch gestures instead of the iOS touch wording. In menus, a **left-hand pinch is Back** (right-hand pinch confirms); gameplay lists the real pinch/chirality actions too. The gestures always worked — only the on-screen guide was wrong.

## Install
SideStore/AltStore: the source auto-updates to this version. Or sideload the IPAs below — dev-signed, so SideStore re-signs on install.

Online multiplayer, plus a big round of visionOS and iOS polish.

## New
- **Online Multi Battle** — up to 5 players over WebRTC, on the official `api.apotris.com` server. Verified cross-country on real iPhone + Vision Pro.

## Fixed / improved
- **visionOS gamepad** now works — the controller reaches GCController instead of being turned into a gaze pointer. Left stick doubles as the d-pad.
- **visionOS window** — the move/resize handles are back, and the window is resizable.
- **iOS touch** — tighter d-pad so a left/right press no longer misfires a destructive drop.
- **Pause menu** Restart/Quit work on touch, gaze, and controller.
- **Audio** revives after closing and reopening the visionOS window.
- Bigger on-screen buttons; a gesture reference table in Settings.

## Install
SideStore/AltStore: add the source (auto-updates), or sideload the IPAs below. Dev-signed — SideStore re-signs on install.

**Apotris for iPhone, iPad, and Apple Vision Pro** — the first release.

A native port of [Apotris](https://apotris.com) by akouzoukos: the game's own
engine rebuilt for Apple platforms and presented through Metal (no emulator).

**Install:** add the SideStore source in the [README](../../#install) — Apotris
auto-updates from there. Or grab the `.ipa` below and sideload it directly
(iOS/iPad via SideStore/AltStore/Sideloadly; Vision Pro via SideStore installed
with [iloader](https://github.com/rebelancap/iloader/releases#release-visionos)).

**Highlights**
- All offline modes: Marathon, Sprint, Dig, Ultra, Blitz, Combo, Zen, Master, Death, Training, and CPU battle
- Gesture controls (drag/flick/tap), an optional GB-button overlay with haptics, full game-controller and keyboard support
- Display filters: Sharp / LCD / CRT
- Apple Vision Pro: a crisp, free-resizing window with chirality pinch controls and a native control ornament

Online multiplayer isn't in this build yet.
